item.title: ComfyUI-UML: diagrams as nodes, images and shareable source
item.description:
antoinebou12/ComfyUI-UML

★ 3 · 3 forks · Repository created 2026-02-23

GitHub statistics recorded 2026-10-20.

ComfyUI is useful beyond image generation when an intermediate result can become a node output. ComfyUI-UML applies that idea to diagrams: text enters a rendering node; an image, a saved file, and a shareable URL can leave it.

item.title: uml-mcp — UML diagrams from chat via MCP
item.description:
uml-mcp gives an MCP client real diagram tools: an assistant supplies Mermaid, PlantUML, or another supported diagram source, and the server returns rendered output and useful links. The current repository documents five tools and a catalog of roughly 37 Kroki-backed types. Those counts describe the documented interface, not a rendering benchmark.

item.title: D2C OpenAI plugin — diagrams with PlantUML, Mermaid, and D2
item.description: D2COpenAIPlugin is a ChatGPT plugin that turns conversation into PlantUML, Mermaid, or D2 without leaving the thread. I built it when OpenAI plugins were the main extension story — useful for architecture sketches, lab docs, and “draw this flow” moments in chat.

item.title: Diagram prompts with ChatGPT and AIPRM (PlantUML, Mermaid, and more)
item.description: I got tired of one-off ChatGPT threads that “draw a sequence diagram” and return half-random syntax. AIPRM helps because the template lives in the browser; I lock four fields — diagram type, elements, purpose, tool — and the model stops guessing whether I want PlantUML, Mermaid, or notes for Draw.io. Related: the D2C OpenAI diagram plugin post.

item.title: D2COpenAIPlugin

D2COpenAIPlugin

Join the ChatGPT plugins waitlist here!

D2COpenAIPlugin is a ChatGPT plugin that generates diagrams with PlantUML or Mermaid from the conversation.

Features

  • Generate diagrams using PlantUML or Mermaid
  • Works as a ChatGPT plugin
  • Diagram-oriented UI

Installation

Before using the plugin, make sure to have the following prerequisites installed:

  • Python 3.6+
  • FastAPI
  • uvicorn
  1. Install Python 3.10, if not already installed.
  2. Clone the repository: git clone https://github.com/antoinebou12/D2COpenAIPlugin.git
  3. Navigate to the cloned repository directory: cd /path/to/D2COpenAIPlugin
  4. Install poetry: pip install poetry
  5. Create a new virtual environment with Python 3.10: poetry env use python3.10
  6. Activate the virtual environment: poetry shell
  7. Install app dependencies: poetry install
